newsitem.title: USA: CSX commences payment for Conrail stake.
newsitem.headline: CSX commences payment for Conrail stake.

text.p: CSX Corp said on Tuesday that it has commenced payment for 19.9 percent of Conrail Inc's shares it accepted for payment under its $110 a share tender offer.
The final proration factor under the tender offer is 23.451836 percent, CSX said.

If a person tendered 100 shares, CSX will pay $110 cash on 23.451836 shares of Conrail tendered, a CSX spokesman said. The cash and stock deal is valued at approximately $8.5 billion, the spokesman said.
The balance of the shares would be returned for a later tender offer, the spokesman said.
A second step to acquire 20.1 percent of Conrail will come if shareholders approve CSX bidding for more stock in a December 23, 1996 shareholder vote, a CSX spokesman said.
The balance of shares will be exchanged upon approval by the Surface Transportation Board, which has oversight over railroad mergers, a CSX spokesman said.
CSX will issue 1.86 shares of CSX for each Conrail share upon approval, which is expected by late 1997 or early 1998, a CSX spokesman said.
